Question: There are lily pads in a row numbered \(0\) to \(11,\) in that order. There are predators on lily pads \(3\) and \(6,\) and a morsel of food on lily pad \(10.\) Fiona the frog starts on pad \(0,\) and from any given lily pad, has a \(\dfrac12\) chance to hop to the next pad, and an equal chance to jump \(2\) pads. What is the probability that Fiona reaches pad \(10\) without landing on either pad \(3\) or pad \(6?\)
